name: Git + GitHub CLI
description: Installs git and the GitHub CLI (gh) into the workspace, survives restarts, and provides a settings panel for gh login (token stored in the zero-knowledge secret store).

git_user_name.description: git config --global user.name. Filled in automatically from your GitHub account when you sign in — set it here only to override.

git_user_email.description: git config --global user.email. Filled in automatically from your GitHub account when you sign in (a private email becomes the GitHub noreply address, which still authors pushes correctly).

watchdog_enabled.description: Watch the workspace's repos and notify (persistent notification) when a repo has uncommitted changes.

watchdog_interval_s.description: How often (seconds) the uncommitted-changes watchdog re-scans the workspace's repos. Minimum 30s.

apps.reason: The repos nav's "show diff" arrow opens aw-app-diff-tool's window (POST /api/apps/diff-tool/diffs/render). See tekflox/aw-app-diff-tool README.
